title: Visually differentiate the icons of playing vs non-playing apps
line: The Media Player widget now shows a small playing badge on the tabs of players that are currently playing.
explanation: When several media players are open, the Media Player widget shows one tab per player with just the app's icon, so there was no way to see which of them were actually playing without clicking through every tab. Each tab button now reads the player's playbackStatus from the model and, while it is Playing, shows Breeze's media-playback-playing status icon as a small badge on the bottom corner of the app icon. The 'Choose player automatically' tab is never badged, and the badge follows playback changes live.

commits.message:
applets/mediacontroller: badge the tabs of players that are playing

With many players open, the tabs at the top of the Media Player popup
all looked the same, so you couldn't tell which ones were playing. Tabs
of players that are currently playing now get a small playing badge.

BUG: 434689

patches.diff:
From d9f55b833b683a88805eaee281fd096f2183040c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 17:47:45 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/mediacontroller: badge the tabs of players that are
 playing

With many players open, the tabs at the top of the Media Player popup
all looked the same, so you couldn't tell which ones were playing. Tabs
of players that are currently playing now get a small playing badge.

BUG: 434689
---
 applets/mediacontroller/ExpandedRepresentation.qml | 12 ++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 12 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/mediacontroller/ExpandedRepresentation.qml b/applets/mediacontroller/ExpandedRepresentation.qml
index 38d591fa14..e10e5a5dd6 100644
--- a/applets/mediacontroller/ExpandedRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/mediacontroller/ExpandedRepresentation.qml
@@ -832,6 +832,7 @@ PlasmaExtras.Representation {
                     required property string iconName
                     required property bool isMultiplexer
                     required property string identity
+                    required property int playbackStatus
                     required property int index
                     anchors.top: parent?.top
                     anchors.bottom: parent?.bottom
@@ -858,6 +859,17 @@ PlasmaExtras.Representation {
                     PlasmaComponents3.ToolTip.text: text
                     PlasmaComponents3.ToolTip.delay: Kirigami.Units.toolTipDelay
                     PlasmaComponents3.ToolTip.visible: hovered || (visualFocus && (focusReason === Qt.TabFocusReason || focusReason === Qt.BacktabFocusReason))
+
+                    Kirigami.Icon {
+                        anchors.left: parent.contentItem.horizontalCenter
+                        anchors.top: parent.contentItem.verticalCenter
+                        anchors.leftMargin: Math.round((parent.icon.height - width) / 2)
+                        anchors.topMargin: Math.round((parent.icon.height - height) / 2)
+                        width: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.small
+                        height: width
+                        visible: !parent.isMultiplexer && parent.playbackStatus === Mpris.PlaybackStatus.Playing
+                        source: "media-playback-playing"
+                    }
                 }
             }
         }
--

media.caption: Before: Chrome and Konsole are playing, Dolphin and Kate are paused, but all tabs look the same
After: the Chrome and Konsole tabs carry a small playing badge

reviews.text: Using the model's playbackStatus role to badge playing tabs in ExpandedRepresentation.qml is the right direction and matches the bug discussion, but the current badge visual design and anchor math have clear issues visible in after-1.png. Adding Math.round((parent.icon.height - width) / 2) to horizontalCenter/verticalCenter pushes the 16x16 badge 8 px outside the 22x22 icon's right and bottom edges, placing it right onto the active tab's bottom highlight line (which wasn't tested with a playing tab selected) and risking overflow into adjacent tabs when many players are open. Additionally, overlaying the monochrome transparent-interior media-playback-playing status icon directly over colorful or dark app icons lets the underlying icon bleed through the square outline and hurts contrast.
changes: Fix the badge anchoring and size so it sits neatly on the bottom-right corner of the 22px app icon (within or close to the icon bounds) without colliding with the active tab's bottom highlight or overflowing narrow tabs when many players are open.

Give the playing badge an opaque, contrasting background (for example a small circular badge containing media-playback-start, or a proper emblem icon) instead of overlaying the transparent-interior monochrome media-playback-playing status icon directly onto app icons.

Re-verify with a currently playing tab selected and with many players open (narrow tabs) to confirm there is no overlap or clipping, and consider reflecting the playing state in the tab tooltip or Accessible.description.

reviews.text: Implements the badge approach Nicolas proposed and Nate and the reporter agreed on (c2, c4, c6-c7): each player tab reads the existing playbackStatus model role (which already emits dataChanged, so it updates live) and shows the stock media-playback-playing icon on the bottom corner of the app icon, never on the automatic tab. It is a small, self-contained QML change in the right place; the Breeze status icon stands in for the missing emblem-play Nate mentioned. The after screenshot clearly marks the two playing players and leaves paused ones alone, and the commit message matches the diff. Nitpick: the badge is not reflected in the tab's accessible name/tooltip (e.g. "Chrome — playing"), which would be a nice touch for screen-reader users.
